name: Songs of Syx
description: Reference for the colony-sim/4X Songs of Syx: the game's own in-game mechanics guide, searchable and citable, generated verbatim from the shipped data. Room/resource/race/tech stat lookups and live colony state via an in-game mod are forthcoming.
limitations: Reference data only for now — the in-game mod that pushes live colony state is not yet shipped
Reference data is generated from the game-shipped data files for a single game version; modded content is not included

guide.name: Mechanics Guide
guide.description: Look up Songs of Syx gameplay mechanics from the game's own shipped in-game guide and room notes. Returns a table of contents, full article text by key, or keyword matches — all dev-written, version-matched prose. Use PROACTIVELY before answering ANY question about how a system works (happiness, services, immigration, farming, military, trade, world map, law): this game is niche and easily mis-remembered, so ground and cite the article instead of guessing.

key.description: For op 'article': the article's LINK_KEY from the index (case-insensitive), e.g. 'STANDINGS'.

op.description: 'index' (default) returns the table of contents; 'article' returns one article's full text; 'search' returns matching articles.

q.description: For op 'search': a keyword matched against article titles and bodies, e.g. 'happiness'.
